notes.title: "DIGITAL EXORCIST" to Exhibit at Tokyo Game Show 2025
notes.content: [h1]"DIGITAL EXORCIST" to Exhibit at Tokyo Game Show 2025[/h1][h2]Play the Latest Demo at Makuhari Messe![/h2][p][/p][p]"DIGITAL EXORCIST" is officially announced to participate in Tokyo Game Show 2025 (TGS2025), held at Makuhari Messe from September 25 (Thursday) to September 28 (Sunday), 2025. Attendees will have the opportunity to experience the latest playable demo of the game at the dedicated booth, and we will also be running a campaign where those who add the game to their Wishlist will receive an original acrylic keychain. [/p][p]*Please note that numbers are limited.[/p][p][/p][h3]Exhibition Details[/h3][quote][p][b]Dates:[/b] September 25 (Thursday) - September 28 (Sunday), 2025[/p][p][b]Times:[/b][/p][p]Business Days (September 25 - 26): 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM[/p][p]Public Day (September 27): 9:30 AM - 5:00 PM[/p][p]Public Day (September 28): 9:30 AM - 4:30 PM[/p][p][b]Venue:[/b] Makuhari Messe[/p][p][b]Booth Name:[/b] HYPER REAL[/p][p][b]Location:[/b] Hall 11 | Booth Number E19[/p][/quote][p][/p][p]We look forward to welcoming you to our booth![/p]
